worst_queue_order_count.meaning: number of orders in the worst price limit queue before the new order is added

new_order_introduces_new_limit.meaning: the new order being added introduces a new limit/price queue on the side

limits_per_side_after_add.meaning: number of price limits on the order book side after the new order is added

max_num_limits_per_side.meaning: the configured maximum number of price limits allowed per side (maxNumLimitsPerSide)

assumptions: The checked action is adding a new order to the order book side, as described in add_order_action.
maxNumLimitsPerSide is a configured per-side limit on the number of price limits.
The least competitive price order removal is the mechanism intended to keep the side within the limit.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric value for maxNumLimitsPerSide or for the queue/limit counts; the bound is kept symbolic.

limitations: The report does not state the caller or any authorization condition, so none is encoded.
The exact numeric value of maxNumLimitsPerSide is not provided; the bound is symbolic.
Only the max_limits_exceeded impact is formalized; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
